items.prompt:
The main point of an informational text is its:
A) central idea
B) title font
C) page count

An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key ideas without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key ideas without opinion

items.prompt:
Details that back up the central idea are:
A) supporting ideas
B) counterclaims
C) titles

Read.

Exercise improves health: it strengthens the heart, builds muscle, and boosts mood and focus.

The central idea is that exercise:
A) is boring
B) improves health
C) only builds muscle

Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of that passage?
A) Everyone should obviously exercise; it's the best.
B) Exercise improves health by strengthening the body and boosting mood and focus.
C) I love exercising.
items.answer: B) Exercise improves health by strengthening the body and boosting mood and focus.

solution.answer: B) Exercise improves health by strengthening the body and boosting mood and focus.

items.prompt:
A central idea is built up by:
A) supporting ideas and details across the text
B) only the first sentence
C) the cover
items.answer: A) supporting ideas and details across the text

steps: Develops over text. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) supporting ideas and details across the text

items.prompt:
Read.

Antibiotics have saved millions of lives, but overusing them has bred resistant bacteria, making some infections untreatable.

The central idea is that antibiotics:
A) are useless
B) save lives, yet overuse creates dangerous resistance
C) should never be used
items.answer: B) save lives, yet overuse creates dangerous resistance

steps: Both sides = central idea. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) save lives, yet overuse creates dangerous resistance

items.prompt:
Which sentence would NOT belong in an objective summary of an article on solar power?
A) Solar panels produce no emissions while generating electricity.
B) Solar power is obviously the only choice any sensible person would make.
C) Installing panels can be costly up front.
items.answer: B) Solar power is obviously the only choice any sensible person would make.

solution.answer: B) Solar power is obviously the only choice any sensible person would make.
